# Devon Retail Service Commitment
Standard parcel orders are committed within **72 hours from carrier pickup**. A delay is a breach only after that window expires.

# Atlas Components Premium SLA
Premium delivery is committed within **48 hours from carrier pickup**. If the commitment is breached, operations must notify the customer and open the exception-specific escalation procedure. Weather is not an automatic waiver.

# Boreal Medical Delivery SLA
International deliveries are committed within **72 hours from carrier pickup**. Customs review does not count as a breach until the 72-hour commitment expires.

# Cedar Industrial Fulfillment Terms
Orders on an active credit hold must not be dispatched. Finance or a manager must clear the hold before release.

# Delta Foods Delivery SLA
Domestic delivery target is **48 hours from carrier pickup**. When a carrier reports delay without a confirmed cause, operations must not invent a root cause.

# Epsilon Retail Legacy SLA
Legacy delivery commitment was **24 hours from carrier pickup**. This version expired on 2026-07-31.

# Epsilon Retail Current SLA
Effective 2026-08-01, delivery commitment is **72 hours from carrier pickup**. This version supersedes the 24-hour legacy SLA.

# Foxtrot Labs SLA
Delivery commitment is **48 hours from carrier pickup**. If authoritative operational systems disagree on delivered status, the assistant must surface the conflict rather than choose one silently.

# Gamma Motors SLA
Delivery commitment is **72 hours from carrier pickup**. Address-validation exceptions follow the trusted address-resolution SOP.

# Helios Services SLA
Delivery commitment is **48 hours from carrier pickup**. Mechanical carrier exceptions use the mechanical-breakdown escalation SOP.

# Indigo Pharma Terms
Standard order and invoice records may be joined by order identifier. Finance details remain role-restricted.

# Juno Office SLA
Domestic delivery commitment is **48 hours from carrier pickup**.

# Kappa Electronics Fulfillment Terms
Orders cannot dispatch until required inventory is allocated. Inventory shortage is an operational blocker independent of finance hold state.
